summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting the results of Forrester Research's 2026 annual shareholder meeting. Items 5.02 and 5.07 disclose the re-election of six directors and approval of an increase in shares under the employee stock purchase plan by 450,000 shares, along with ratification of auditors and a non-binding say-on-pay vote. All proposals passed with routine support. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or other special situation is indicated. The item 1.01 agreement is a compensatory plan amendment. This is a routine governance update.
